subject: Amendment Required: Draft Bill of Lading Discrepancies
body:
Dear Partner,

We have reviewed the draft Bill of Lading against the Shipping Instruction, which serves as our authoritative reference, and found a few discrepancies that need your attention.

For the Consignee, the Shipping Instruction states EAST BRIGHT FZ-LLC, while the draft Bill of Lading currently shows UAB NOVAKOPA.

Similarly, for the Notify Party, the Shipping Instruction indicates EAST BRIGHT FZ-LLC, whereas the draft Bill of Lading lists UAB NOVAKOPA.

Please amend the draft Bill of Lading to match the Shipping Instruction at your earliest convenience.

Best regards,
Shipping Operations
